Here are a few options for your LinkedIn post, choose the one that best fits your style!

---

**Option 1: Enthusiastic & Direct**

📢 **Big news! After years of working with the CDS Hooks standard since 2017, I'm absolutely thrilled to announce I've joined the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee!**

This is a fantastic opportunity, and I'm incredibly excited to collaborate with this talented group to help shape the future and further grow the impact of CDS Hooks in healthcare. My journey with this standard has been deeply rewarding, and now I get to contribute to its evolution from an even more central position.

**If you're already leveraging CDS Hooks in your applications, we'd love to hear about it!** Please consider adding your implementation to our growing list at: 👉 [https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability](https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability) Your contributions help showcase the breadth of adoption and inspire others.

**Not using CDS Hooks yet, but curious about its potential to enhance your clinical workflows?** Let's chat! I'm available as a freelance consultant to help you navigate the implementation process and unlock the power of real-time clinical decision support. Feel free to connect or send me a message!

#CDSHooks #HealthcareIT #Innovation #ProjectManagementCommittee #ClinicalDecisionSupport #FHIR #HealthTech #Consulting

---

**Option 2: Reflective & Forward-Looking**

It's truly a privilege to share some exciting personal news today! Having first delved into the world of **CDS Hooks** back in 2017, I've seen firsthand the transformative power of this standard in clinical decision support. Today, I'm honored and incredibly enthusiastic to announce that I've been invited to join the **CDS Hooks Project Management Committee!**

This new role is a fantastic progression in my journey with CDS Hooks, and I'm eager to contribute to its strategic direction and continued advancement. I believe deeply in its ability to empower clinicians and improve patient care, and I'm committed to helping move the standard forward.

**To all the innovators out there already using CDS Hooks:** We're building a vibrant community, and your participation is key! Please take a moment to add your implementation to our availability wiki: [https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability](https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability) Let's celebrate our collective impact!

**For organizations exploring CDS Hooks but needing a guiding hand:** If you're looking to implement this powerful standard but aren't sure where to start, know that I'm available as a freelance consultant to assist with your adoption strategy and technical implementation. Don't hesitate to reach out!

#CDSHooks #HealthcareTechnology #Leadership #Standardization #HealthInnovation #FreelanceConsultant #DigitalHealth

---

**Option 3: Concise & Action-Oriented**

Thrilled to announce that after building and working with the **CDS Hooks** standard since 2017, I've officially joined the **CDS Hooks Project Management Committee!**

I'm incredibly excited to contribute to the future direction and growth of this vital standard. My passion lies in seeing CDS Hooks empower more effective clinical decision support, and I'm ready to help drive that mission forward.

**Are you using CDS Hooks?** Please add your implementation to our wiki! Let's showcase the community's adoption: [https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability](https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability)

**Considering CDS Hooks but need expert guidance?** I'm available as a freelance consultant to help you implement and optimize this powerful standard. Connect with me to discuss your needs!

#CDSHooksPMC #HealthcareIT #StandardDevelopment #ClinicalWorkflow #ConsultingServices #HealthTech

---

**Remember to also:**

*   **Add a professional headshot or a relevant image** (e.g., the CDS Hooks logo) to your post.
*   **Engage with comments** you receive.
*   **Consider tagging relevant organizations or individuals** if appropriate (e.g., if you know other PMC members on LinkedIn).
